# Causal Modality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CausalModality`](gmeow-CausalModality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CausalModality>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The force of a causal link — an OPEN value vocabulary seeded with necessitates (the antecedent suffices), promotes (raises likelihood), enables (makes possible), prevents (blocks). Distinct from [`gmeow:standpointModality`](../properties/gmeow-standpointModality.md) (doxastic — how firmly a frame believes the link) and from [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](../properties/gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md) (ontic): causal modality is what the link CLAIMS about the world's mechanics.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CausalModality`](gmeow-CausalModality.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
